post.description: Creates a new user account and sends an email confirmation link.

get.description: Validates the confirmation token and marks the user's email as confirmed.

post.description: Resends the email confirmation link. No-op if the email is already confirmed or does not exist.

204.description: Confirmation email sent (or silently skipped if already confirmed)

post.description: Authenticates a confirmed user and returns an access + refresh token pair.
Issues a new access + refresh token pair using a valid refresh token.

401.description: Invalid, expired, or reused refresh token

post.description: Sends a password reset email. No-op if the email is not registered.

204.description: Reset email sent (or silently skipped if email not found)

post.description: Resets the user password using a valid reset token.
Revokes all active refresh tokens for the authenticated user.

get.description: Returns the authenticated user's profile from the JWT payload.

patch.description: Updates nickname, name and/or description. An empty description clears it.

post.description: Creates the video draft and opens a multipart upload in object storage.

400.description: Validation failed, file too large or unsupported media type

post.description: Issues presigned UploadPart URLs so the client sends parts straight to object storage.

400.description: Validation failed or part number out of range

404.description: Video not found or not owned by the caller

409.description: Video is not in a state that accepts uploads

post.summary: Get presigned URLs for upload parts

get.description: Lists the parts already stored for the open multipart upload so an interrupted upload can resume.

404.description: Video not found or not owned by the caller

409.description: Video is not in a state that accepts uploads

post.description: Finalizes the multipart upload, validates the stored size and queues the video for processing.

400.description: Validation failed, parts mismatch, size mismatch or file too large

404.description: Video not found or not owned by the caller

409.description: Video is not in a state that accepts uploads

delete.description: Aborts the open multipart upload and discards the video draft.

404.description: Video not found or not owned by the caller

409.description: Video is no longer a draft

get.description: Videos in `pronto` are public. Any other status is visible only to the owner (send the access token).

404.description: Video not found, or not visible to the caller

patch.description: Updates title, description, category and visibility. Only the informed fields change.

409.description: Video upload is still in progress

get.description: Returns a short-lived signed URL; the player streams straight from object storage with Range support.

404.description: Video not found, or not visible to the caller

409.description: The owner asked for a video that is not ready yet

get.description: Returns a short-lived signed URL that makes the browser save the file under its original name.

404.description: Video not found, or not visible to the caller

409.description: The owner asked for a video that is not ready yet

404.description: Video not found or not owned by the caller

409.description: Video is not ready or is already published

put.description: Accepts a JPEG, PNG or WebP image, resizes it to fit 1280x720 and stores it as JPEG.

404.description: Video not found or not owned by the caller

get.description: Management panel listing with offset pagination, sorting and publication state filter.

400.description: Malformed cursor or limit out of range

get.summary: List the public videos of a channel

videoCount.description: Published and public videos of the channel
